description.value: The Galley Patio & Grill is a casual, long-running waterfront restaurant at the Jericho Sailing Centre in Vancouver, serving West Coast comfort food including beer-battered BC rockfish, locally sourced burgers, and seasonal salads on an open patio. It has been operating since at least 2003 — its signature Jamaican Jerk Chicken Burger is noted as a Galley original from that year — and sources humanely raised beef from Semlin Valley Ranch in Cache Creek. The restaurant also provides catering for events at the Jericho Sailing Centre, making it a well-established fixture on Vancouver's western waterfront cycling corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content from thegalley.ca is fully accessible and provides the authoritative address (1300 Discovery Street, Vancouver, BC V6R 4L9), phone (604-222-1331), and full menu. The menu explicitly includes vegetarian options (Jericho Veggie Burger, Mish-Mash Salad) supporting a value=true for that amenity. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, takeout, or other cycle-touring amenities appears anywhere on the site, so those are null. A name discrepancy exists: OSM tags the business as 'The Galley Restaurant and Grill' while the website consistently uses 'The Galley Patio & Grill.'

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established waterfront restaurant at the Jericho Sailing Centre on a popular Vancouver cycling route; active website, confirmed address and phone, broad menu including vegetarian options, and a long operating history make it a useful and credible stop for touring cyclists.
